claim: Van Abbemuseum in Eindhoven is open Tuesday–Sunday 11:00–17:00, adults €16, under-13 free, free Tuesdays 15:00–17:00; closed 1 Jan, 14 Feb (carnival), 27 Apr (King's Day), 5 May 2026.
quote: Adults: €16.00; Children under 13 years: €0.00; Family pass: €32.00 ... Admission to the museum is free on Tuesdays from 3 to 5 pm. ... closed on January 1 2026 ... April 27 2026 (King's Day), May 5 2026

claim: The Philips Museum sits where Gerard Philips made his first light bulbs in 1891 and traces the company's rise from light bulbs to CDs to healthcare tech, with an iPad-led augmented-reality tour.
quote: tells the extraordinary story of the light-bulb maker turned multinational electronics company who invented the CD ... The iPad-led 'augmented-reality' tour adds nine extra design-focused elements

claim: Philips Museum admission is €12.50 adults / €6 students, free Tuesdays from 15:30 outside school holidays; the Evoluon (1966 retro-futurist dome) charges €16 / €8 students and opens Wed–Sun 11:00–17:00.
quote: Price: €12.50 for adults, €6 for students, free on Tuesdays from 3:30 PM ... Evoluon ... A regular ticket costs €16, and €8 for students; Opening hours: Wednesday to Sunday from 11 AM until 5 PM

claim: Strijp-S is Eindhoven's repurposed Philips factory district, now a creative hub of design studios, MU Hybrid Art House, Area 51 skatepark, food trucks and the annual Dutch Design Week.
quote: Strijp-S serves as a hub for creative professionals, hosting exhibitions, workshops, and events ... MU Hybrid Art House features contemporary exhibitions ... Area 51 Skatepark is one of the largest skateparks in Europe

claim: Eurocircuit Valkenswaard is the only permanent off-road racing centre in the Netherlands, 1033 m long (60% paved, 40% unpaved), set in forest between Eindhoven and the Belgian border; a Rallycross weekend is scheduled 20–21 June 2026.
quote: The Eurocircuit is located near Valkenswaard in a forested environment between Eindhoven and the Belgian border, and is the only permanent Off Road Racing Center in the Netherlands ... 1033 meters, of which 60% is paved and 40% unpaved

claim: Sint-Martinuskerk in Weert is a late-Gothic hall church with a 72 m tower, one of only two such hallenkerken left in the Netherlands and home to among the largest continuous late-Gothic vault paintings in the country.
quote: Sint Martinus Church in Weert is an imposing, late-gothic hall church. The 72-metre high tower ... one of only two remaining examples of this architectural style in late-gothic in the Netherlands ... largest continuous late Gothic vault paintings

claim: Sint-Martinuskerk visitor hours are Tue–Fri 11:00–12:00 (Mar–Oct) and 14:00–16:00, Saturday 09:00–16:00, Sunday 14:00–16:00.
quote: open for viewing Tuesday to Friday from 11:00 to 12:00 (March through October) and 14:00 to 16:00, Saturday 09:00 to 16:00 and Sunday 14:00 to 16:00

claim: Recreatiegebied de IJzerenman in Weert is a sport-and-relaxation lake area combining swimming at Zwembad De IJzeren Man, natural camping Wega, a petting farm and minigolf.
quote: Recreatiegebied de IJzerenman is a versatile sports, relaxation and recreation area in Weert, with swimming at Zwembad De IJzeren Man, relaxation at natural camping Wega ... feed goats, lambs and rabbits at a petting farm or play minigolf

claim: 't Spectrum was founded in Bergeijk in 1941 as a sister to weaving mill De Ploeg; Martin Visser headed its design department from 1954 and hired Friso Kramer, Constant Nieuwenhuys and Benno Premsela, producing icons like the BR 02 sofa bed.
quote: 't Spectrum was founded in Bergeijk in 1941 ... In 1954 Martin Visser became head of Spectrum's design department ... hired great designers such as Friso Kramer, Constant Nieuwenhuys and Benno Premsela ... BR 02 sofa bed as its most famous icon

claim: Achel Brewery in Hamont-Achel lost Trappist status in January 2021 when the last monks moved to Westmalle and entrepreneur Jan Torman bought the abbey complex; brewing continues but is no longer Trappist.
quote: The Achel Brewery was a Belgian Trappist brewery until January 2021 and continues to operate as a brewery but is no longer Trappist ... the abbey buildings and brewery were bought by Belgian entrepreneur Jan Torman

claim: Achelse Kluis monastery itself is closed to visitors but the on-site café/shop and brasserie serve regional dishes and the abbey's beers, with extended Apr–Nov hours Tue–Sun (closed Mondays).
quote: The monastery itself is not open for visitors, but there is a cafe and shop on premise you can visit ... De Kluis 1, 3930 Hamont-Achel

claim: Beekse Bergen safari park in Hilvarenbeek is 53.7 km / about 50 min drive from Lommel — outside the 30 km radius.
quote: The distance between Lommel and Safaripark Beekse Bergen is 67 km, while the road distance is 53.7 km. It takes approximately 50 minutes to drive
